title_en: Artificial Intelligence (14/20): A Melody Written by AI
note_en: The 是……的 construction highlights how, when, or by whom something already happened: 是软件根据他输入的几个关键词生成的 "it was generated by the software from a few keywords he typed in." English shifts the stress with "It was... that" or just tone of voice, but Chinese brackets the detail it wants to spotlight between 是 and a final 的; the event itself is taken as known.
